description: This file defines an Angular component 'NoteEditorComponent' for editing notes. It includes input properties for passing note data and flags, output events for save and cancel actions, and handles changes to its inputs.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing notes with input properties for note data and editing flags, and output events for save and cancel actions.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates the component state when input properties change.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with the current note title and content.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Emits the cancel event to notify parent component.
